day: # The readings of the Ambrosian Rite: the Lezionario Ambrosiano (2008), from the Archdiocese of Milan's own tables of it,
# the Ordo of each of its three books (Libro I: Il Mistero dell'Incarnazione; Libro II: Il Mistero della Pasqua; Libro III:
# Il Mistero della Pentecoste), Sundays and feasts (ordinamento festivo) and weekdays (ordinamento feriale):
# Checked day by day against the Archdiocese's readings of each day, 2012-13 to 2025-26,
# Sundays and feasts: three years, cycle A, B, C (A = the year beginning in November 2025). Weekdays: two years, cycle I and II
#   (I = the year beginning in November 2024, as the Archdiocese reads it: Geremia in Advent, I settimana).
# Citations in English book names; the Lectionary's psalms, numbered as in the Greek and Latin Bible (Salmo 50), are given their
#   Hebrew number (Psalm 51), their verses as it gives them (verse_numbering Psalms). 'Cfr.' is left out; 'op' (oppure) is 'or'.
# kind: ot (Lettura, and Geremia, Genesi ... of the weekdays), ot2 (Profeti, Proverbi), psalm (Salmo, Salmello), epistle
#   (Epistola), verse (Canto al Vangelo), gospel, resurrection (the Sunday's Vangelo della Risurrezione), vigil (Lent's Lettura vigiliare).
